recent.text: Pelicans trail Spurs 89-66. It's been a Wemby show, with San Antonio also enjoying a ton of great looks from 3-point range. Jeremiah Fears: 24 PTS (8-15 FG), 4 REB, 4 AST Victor Wembanyama: 40 PTS (16-22 FG), 16 REB, 4 STL, 5 BLK, 3 3s

recent.text: Jeremiah Fears (22 pts) and Jordan Poole (15 pts) have done the heavy lifting offensively for #Pelicans, trying to keep the Spurs within shouting distance. It's been a major struggle with efficiency otherwise

recent.text: Pelicans trail Spurs 61-45 at halftime. When Victor Wembanyama's (32 PTS, +29 +/-) been on the floor, San Antonio has dominated the action, but when he's sat, New Orleans has been incredibly effective. Jeremiah Fears: 16 PTS, 3 AST, 2 STL Jordan Poole: 13 PTS, 3 3s

recent.text: Second time in this first half that Pelicans and Spurs need to be separated. First moment involved Jaron Pierre Jr and Keldon Johnson. Now, Jeremiah Fears and De'Aaron Fox. Feistiness meter is high. Good to see from a Pelicans team that's lost 8 of last 9 games.

recent.text: Pelicans trail Spurs 32-29 after 12 minutes. Rollercoaster of a quarter: Pels started poorly, trailing 15-4, then went on 22-8 run to seize 26-23 lead but Spurs with final laugh, ending frame on 9-3 run. Jeremiah Fears: 11 PTS, 2 AST Jordan Poole: 9 PTS, 3 3s Herb Jones: 3 STL
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: Jordan Poole has been a factor in #Pelicans improving three-point accuracy in recent weeks, after rough beginning. Poole started 3/14 from deep this season in October, but in November he is now 14/31 (45%)
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Queen is now playing with his left eye partially closed, after he was accidentally poked in the face by Victor Wembanyama, as Wemby was making a crosscourt pass. Queen has only missed one game in his career to injury

recent.text: The Pelicans have jumped out to a 91-76 lead over the Thunder in the third quarter. Herb Jones’ two three-pointers have expanded the lead — and it’s the first time he’s made more than 3 triples in a game this season. The Pelicans are playing outstanding TEAM basketball.
